reread.title: Roadblocks on the Road to Grandma's House: Fertility Consequences of Delayed Retirement
reread.why: GOLD RECORD, blindly rejected by the screen, and the recovered abstract CONFIRMS the rejection: it exploits a decade of Italian pension reforms that lengthened the grandparental generation's working horizon, treating that as a negative shock to informal childcare SUPPLY. The exposure is the grandmother's availability, not the arrangement. An independent source vindicating a blinded rejection of a hand-picked anchor.
